exposure: Fetal MRI field strength (1.5 Tesla vs 3 Tesla)
outcome: Discrimination of mild hypoplasia from slight deformation of the cerebellar vermis
cohort: The study describes two individual fetuses with posterior fossa malformations, one undergoing 1.5T MRI and the other 3T MRI.
finding: Mid-gestational MRI at 3 Tesla has the potential to exclude pronounced vermian hypoplasia with higher confidence than at 1.5 Tesla, although distinguishing mild hypoplasia remains challenging.
